name: New Prahv
description: The Azorius guildhall where law runes are written in the sky.

timeline.summary: Relov files an Application for Constant Protection on returning to New Prahv.
timeline.quote: As soon as Relov got back to New Prahv, he filled out an Application for Constant Protection.

timeline.summary: Relov is turned to stone, and his statue is installed near the main gate and mistaken for one of Grand Arbiter Leonos.
timeline.quote: No one looked long enough to see the uncanny resemblance to the missing Relov or the terror in his unblinking eyes.

timeline.summary: Relov processes paperwork, dismissing Mr. Lapt's application over a spelling error and approving a new statue of Grand Arbiter Leonos.
timeline.quote: Learn to spell, Mr. Lapt, and stop wasting my precious time.

timeline.summary: Relov signs an Orzhov enforcer's urgent application despite twelve statute violations when he sees the bribe amount.
timeline.quote: The request violated twelve statutes, but when Relov saw the pale pink number printed at the bottom, he signed without hesitation.

timeline.summary: Relov receives a cryptic letter from Javy asking him to come, after a year of silence since she and her partner were attacked.
timeline.quote: What is the culmination of a life of words? Buckets of blood. Come now.

timeline.summary: After months of negotiation, Reza has solved the Thinktank Jurisdictional Fallacy with a fifty-seven page proposal.
timeline.quote: I'd solved the Fallacy. For real this time.

timeline.summary: Tagan tells Reza she can no longer be his mentor because it is time he becomes a mentor himself.
timeline.quote: I can't be your mentor anymore, because I think it's time you become a mentor yourself.
